findings.title: Crawl error encountered
findings.impact: The audit could not access or analyze a page.

findings.title: Very little readable text detected
findings.evidence: The crawled page contains approximately 2 readable words, which is very little textual content for machine interpretation.
findings.impact: A page with very little machine-readable text may provide insufficient explicit context for automated systems.

suggested_action.summary: Ensure the page explicitly states its main purpose, key facts, entities, and user-relevant information in readable HTML text.

findings.title: No H1 heading detected
findings.evidence: The page contains no detectable <h1> heading element in the DOM tree.
findings.impact: Visitors and search crawlers may have less immediate orientation about the primary subject of the page.

suggested_action.summary: Add one clear, descriptive H1 heading that states the main purpose or subject of the page.

findings.title: Page appears to be a navigation dead end
findings.evidence: No outbound navigation links or next-step actions were detected on the crawled page.
findings.impact: Visitors reaching this page have no visible pathways to discover more content or continue their journey.

suggested_action.summary: Add relevant internal links or a contextually appropriate next action that helps visitors continue their journey.

findings.title: No clear primary navigation detected
findings.evidence: No <nav> element containing links and no obvious header navigation links were detected on the page.
findings.impact: Visitors may have difficulty discovering related sections or continuing through the website.

suggested_action.summary: Provide a clear, consistently placed primary navigation with descriptive links to the site main sections.

findings.title: Missing meta description
findings.evidence: No <meta name="description"> tag was found in the HTML document head.
findings.impact: The page provides less explicit summary metadata for crawlers and snippet generators.

suggested_action.summary: Add a concise meta description that accurately summarizes the page content.

findings.title: Missing Open Graph metadata
findings.evidence: No Open Graph meta properties (og:title, og:description, og:image) were detected in the page head.
findings.impact: Links shared on social networks or messaging applications will lack customized visual previews.

suggested_action.summary: Include Open Graph tags to improve link previews on social platforms.

findings.title: Missing Twitter Card metadata
findings.evidence: No twitter:card or associated Twitter metadata tags were detected.
findings.impact: Previews on Twitter/X will default to generic fallback formatting.

suggested_action.summary: Include Twitter Card tags to improve link previews on X/Twitter.

findings.title: Consider adding structured data
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD script blocks (<script type="application/ld+json">) were found in the page markup.
findings.impact: The page does not expose Schema.org structured entities for automated knowledge graph ingestion.

suggested_action.summary: Consider adding relevant Schema.org JSON-LD structured data (e.g., Organization, Product, Article) if applicable.
